key_insight: REGEN reuses expert RL replay buffers to train a generalist offline, eliminating the need for costly coupled rollout-and-backprop distillation.
engineering_relevance: It offers a more scalable and cheaper post-training path for LLM reasoning and agentic capabilities by decoupling data generation from model updates.
method: Recycle replay memory produced by specialized expert RL training.
Apply offline RL to distill expert behavior into a generalist model.
Avoid multi-teacher on-policy distillation and repeated online rollouts.
evidence_signal: Across mathematical reasoning, code generation, and instruction following, REGEN matches MOPD accuracy while using substantially lower training cost.
watch_item: Performance depends on the quality and coverage of the experts' replay data, so weak or biased replay buffers may limit generalization.
paper_title: REGEN: Replay-recycling for Expert-to-Generalist distillation with Offline Reinforcement Learning
